tutti.en: all of them; all of the people

texto: Normally, with **avere** the participle ends in neutral **-o**: **Ho comprato la pasta**. But if you replace «la pasta» with the direct pronoun **la**, the participle should match in gender and number: **L'ho comprata**.
**Lo** and **la** are required to elude themselves to «ho, hai, ha, abbiamo, avete, hanno»: **L'ho visto** (I have seen it), **L'ho vista** (I have seen it).
On the other hand, the **li** and **le** NUNCA plurals are used: **Li ho visti** (I have seen them), **Le ho viste** (I have seen them).

filas: Sì, le ho viste sul telefono.

frases.it: Luca, hai fatto la spesa per la cena?
frases.es: Luca, ¿hiciste la compra para la cena?
frases.en: Luca, did you buy for dinner?

frases.it: Sì! Ho comprato la pasta fresca e l'ho già cucinata.
frases.es: ¡Sí! Compré la pasta fresca y ya la cociné.
frases.en: Yes! I bought the fresh pasta and already cooked it.
analisis: I already cooked it (the pasta → l-ho cucinata with -a)

frases.it: E le arance per domani? Dove sono?
frases.en: And the oranges for tomorrow? Where are they?

frases.it: Le ho viste in centro e le ho comprate subito.
frases.es: Las vi en el centro y las compré enseguida.
frases.en: I saw them in the middle and bought them right away.
analisis: I saw them (le arance → I saw him with -e)

frases.it: Bene! Hai chiamato anche gli amici?
frases.en: Good! Did you call friends too?

frases.it: Sì, li ho chiamati un'ora fa e vengono tutti!
frases.es: ¡Sí, los llamé hace una hora y vienen todos!
frases.en: Yeah, I called them an hour ago and they're all coming!
analisis: I called them (gli amici → li ho chiamati with -i)

frases.es: ¡Bien hecho, lo has hecho todo muy bien!
frases.en: Well done, you've done everything very well!

bloques.pregunta: How do you respond to «Hai comprato la pasta?» using a direct pronoun?

opciones.explicacion: «La» is contracted in «l'» and the participle is consistent in feminine singular (-a).
When using the «la» pronoun, the participle must agree to feminine.
In the standard «la», the «ho» (l-ho) is selected and requires the -a termination.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «I've seen the photos and kept them.»?

opciones.texto: Ho visto le foto e le ho guardate.
opciones.explicacion: With the plural feminine pronoun «le», the participle ends in -e (save).

opciones.texto: Ho visto le foto e li ho guardati.
opciones.explicacion: «Foto» is feminine (photo), so it requires the «le» pronoun.

opciones.texto: Ho visto le foto e l'ho guardato.
opciones.explicacion: «li» and «le» plural pronouns are never elated in «l'».

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the direct pronoun masculine plural.
bloques.frase: Dove sono i biglietti del treno? — ___ ho presi stamattina alla stazione.

opciones.explicacion: «Biglietti» is masculine plural: the corresponding pronoun is «li» and causes agreement in -i.
«Le» is used exclusively for plural feminine nouns.
In plural, the pronoun is never apostropied before the verb.

bloques.frase: Ho cercato le chiavi e le ho viste sul tavolo.

opciones.texto: I looked for the keys and I saw them on the table.
opciones.explicacion: Mandatory consistency between the plural feminine pronoun «le» and «viste».

opciones.texto: I looked for the keys, but I didn't find them at home.
opciones.explicacion: He clearly states that he did see them on the table.

opciones.texto: I lost the keys and bought some new ones.
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't mention losing or buying keys.

bloques.pregunta: Why does the participle end in -o?
bloques.frase: Ieri ho incontrato Marco e l'ho invitato a cena.

opciones.texto: Because it matches the direct pronoun masculine singular «lo» (l-ho invitate).
opciones.explicacion: Anteposite to the «avere» auxiliary, the «lo» pronoun forces the masculine singular concordance.

opciones.texto: Because the participles can never change their end.
opciones.explicacion: With direct pronouns above the agreement is mandatory.

bloques.frase: Ho visto le foto e le ho guardate
bloques.traduccion: I've seen the pictures and looked at them.
bloques.explicacion: Pronubre feminine plural «le» opposite with participle concordance in -e.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «Did you call your friends?»?

opciones.explicacion: «Le» is not elided and the participle adopts the plural feminine deinence -e.
The plural pronoun «le» never apostrophies as «l'».
With «le» the participle cannot be left in neutral -o termination.

intro: When a direct pronoun precedes the prossimo passage with «avere», the participle must agree with it.
